source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "land use regulation" OR "land-use regulation" OR zoning AND (urban OR city OR housing)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"land use regulation" OR "land-use regulation" OR zoning AND (urban OR city OR housing),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("land use regulation" OR "land-use regulation" OR ("zoning" AND ("city" OR "housing" OR "urban")))
